component.name: OpenRAC Launcher
component.summary: Set up, build and play the decompiled Ratchet & Clank games

description.p: OpenRAC Launcher is the desktop companion for the PlayStation 2 Ratchet & Clank decompilation projects. It allows players to set up games from their own disc images, play the native PC ports, inspect decompilation progress, and explore levels.

ul.li: Direct extraction and setup from genuine PlayStation 2 game discs (ISO images).
Playable native PC port of Ratchet & Clank (PAL) with hardware 3D rendering.
Integrated level inspection and developer tools.
Zero emulation: executes decompiled native game code directly.
Added official Linux ARM64 (aarch64) native builds and updater support.
Performance and stability improvements in game runtime and level loading.
